fact: LISGIS's Socioeconomic Statistical Bulletin Vol. 4 No. 01 (December 2023), compiled from administrative data of ministries, agencies and commissions under the World Bank HISWA Administrative Data Project, draws on Ministry of Education Annual School Census 2019/2020 returns, the Ministry of Health Health Information System, Ministry of Transport records, Liberia National Police Crime Statistics report and Ministry of Agriculture data.
title: Socioeconomic Statistical Bulletin of Liberia, Vol. 4 No. 01
publisher: Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services (LISGIS)
